vectors.name: Receiver has no smartphone
vectors.behaviour: Voice call with PIN; dispatcher proxy if unanswered

vectors.name: Receiver cannot take but knows who can
vectors.behaviour: DECLINE with redirect suggestion; advance ladder

vectors.name: Receiver can take partly
vectors.behaviour: COUNTER; referrer confirms or escalates within bounded deadline

vectors.name: Duty nurse busy
vectors.behaviour: In-facility ladder to casualty MO, then onward

vectors.name: Two facilities accept at once (parallel mode)
vectors.behaviour: One lease granted; loser receives 409 LEASE_HELD

vectors.name: Late accept before successor ACK
vectors.behaviour: k SOFT_OPEN wins lease; k+1 becomes SUPERSEDED

vectors.name: Late accept after successor ACK
vectors.behaviour: k evicted to TIMED_OUT; late ACCEPT rejected with 409

vectors.name: Accept, then cannot take on arrival
vectors.behaviour: ARRIVAL_REJECTED, lease revoked, ladder advances

vectors.name: All approved facilities fail
vectors.behaviour: ESCALATED_TO_DISPATCHER + DISPATCH_ACTION deadline

vectors.name: Ambulance in dead zone
vectors.behaviour: Observations queue locally; set-union merge on reconnect

vectors.name: Server or internet down
vectors.behaviour: Phone and paper procedures continue; Crockford paper code links

vectors.name: Wrong person accepts
vectors.behaviour: Roster/role/PIN rejected (403); failure counter incremented

vectors.name: Crew cannot use app
vectors.behaviour: Dispatcher or EMT enters status as proxy

vectors.name: Slip arrives with no digital record
vectors.behaviour: Desk enters paper code and links or creates paper-first record

vectors.name: iPhone with restricted background
vectors.behaviour: Foreground flush; no background guarantee claimed

vectors.name: AI draft wrong
vectors.behaviour: Structured entry primary; critical fields verified; works with AI off

vectors.name: Patient stabilises before departure
vectors.behaviour: CANCELLED(reason); open offers withdrawn

vectors.name: Patient refuses transfer
vectors.behaviour: CANCELLED(PATIENT_REFUSED); logged

vectors.name: Ambulance breaks down
vectors.behaviour: Dispatcher reassigns transport; handshake unaffected (I3)

vectors.name: Receiver roster stale (phone changed)
vectors.behaviour: Delivery fails -> next roster channel -> escalate

vectors.name: Counter loop
vectors.behaviour: Max 2 rounds enforced; 3rd counter rejected with 409

vectors.name: Duplicate referral for same patient
vectors.behaviour: Paper-code/identifier match prompts link; no auto-merge

vectors.name: Client clock wrong
vectors.behaviour: Server time authoritative; client time recorded for skew check

vectors.name: SIM theft / PIN guess
vectors.behaviour: Lockout after repeated failures; alert dispatched

vectors.name: Admin override by dispatcher
vectors.behaviour: DISPATCHER_ASSIGN with logged reason enum

vectors.name: Receiver accepts but no bed (gaming)
vectors.behaviour: Separate ARRIVED->HANDED_OVER metric tracked

vectors.name: Tertiary overload
vectors.behaviour: AT_CAPACITY decline; ladder advances

vectors.name: Retry storm from flaky network
vectors.behaviour: Idempotent replay returns cached status and body

vectors.name: Referral never closed
vectors.behaviour: Two-stage CLOSURE deadline auto-closes with UNKNOWN_COUNTER_REFERRAL
